description: Snow Cover Duration - Tundra - Vuntut is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Parks Canada | Parcs Canada. Permafrost and snow are critical to the ecology of many northern ecosystems. They influence hydrology and vegetation and can dramatically affect the quality of wildlife habitat. In recent decades permafrost temperatures in North America have increased and snowfall and spring snow cover in the Arctic have declined. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Parks Canada | Parcs Canada. Its tags are Vuntut, Plaine d’Old Crow, neige, Vuntut, Old Crow Flats. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2024-12-09 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source.
